key_findings.sp_edit_size_median_lines: 14–65 (renames ALL occurrences of ALL selected names)
key_findings.sp_small_overlap_fraction: 19% of SP dev pairs fall in 2–5 line bin
key_findings.root_cause: SC mutators target 1 site; SP transformations rename all occurrences of all selected names. Any method correlated with edit size will appear to discriminate.
key_findings.redesign_strategy: max_names=1 cap: SP-1 and SP-2 rename only 1 variable/function (all occurrences of that one name). Edit size becomes 2*(num_occurrences) ~ 2-8 lines, overlapping SC range.
key_findings.sp_types_naturally_small: SP-5 (loop rewrite, median 4), SP-9 (constant fold, median 2) already produce 2-5 line edits

blockers.decision_required: D1: choose redesign approach (max_names=1 cap on SP-1/SP-2 recommended); implement before generating fresh benchmark
